expectations.assertion: Renders the page chrome (layout, title, controls) immediately rather than waiting on the data
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly describes immediate rendering of title, filters, and table structure at 0ms.

expectations.assertion: Uses a pixel-matched skeleton for the table rows, not a generic spinner or a blank area
expectations.reason: Transcript specifies 30 pixel-matched skeleton rows and explicitly rejects spinners and badges.

expectations.assertion: Transitions the loaded data in by blur (a short fade/blur arrival) instead of an abrupt pop
expectations.reason: Transcript describes blur + opacity transition with spring animation, explicitly avoiding pop-in.

expectations.assertion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion and announces the loading state accessibly (role=status or equivalent)
expectations.reason: Transcript addresses prefers-reduced-motion but never mentions accessible announcement mechanism like role=status or aria-live.
